summary:

The post Solana Mobile Suspends Marketing Email Account After Unauthorized Access appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: Solana Mobile suspended its Brevo marketing email account following an unauthorized access incident linked to a third-party breach. The company confirmed that no emails appear to have been sent from the compromised account. Solana Mobile also reminded users that it never requests sensitive information such as seed phrases or private keys.
